root: ^Altaire: The forge seethes with undying flame. Maerimond's soul is free at last.
^ This burden in Ministeria lies severed, and my brother and I are unshackled from this dread covenant.
^ For that, you have the Golden Order's gratitude.
^Altaire: The flame of this forge shall endure, for you and you alone. This is my reward to you. Step forth, and cast thy sorceries into this flame.
^ Maerimond's wisdom will sharpen them, making your magic keener, in exchange for magic smithing shards.
^Altaire: Now I depart. Strange days await my kingdom. I have a feeling we may yet meet again. Until that hour, fare you well.
